purpose: Fresh held-out proof that supplier-independent PyPI discovery can widen beyond exact project names and acquire a BSON codec without package-name hints.
goal: Create canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/BSON_SOURCE.json containing exactly four records with fields id and text: 1 alpha, 2 beta, 3 gamma, 4 delta. Encode those exact records as BSON and save canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/BSON_RECORDS.bson. Independently decode the BSON artifact and verify the decoded records are exactly identical to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/BSON_SOURCE.json in values, order, field names, and record count.
